purpose: Determine whether the reconnected Google OAuth credential contains the read-only Cloud Platform scope required for the API Keys lookup.
safeguards: Export only the exact Google OAuth credential to a temporary mode-0600 file.
Never print or persist access tokens, refresh tokens, client secrets, or any raw credential fields.
Delete the temporary export after inspection.

finding.likely_missing: IAM permission on the parent project of the selected Gemini API key
finding.certainty: The Cloud Platform OAuth scope is present. The API returned 403 PERMISSION_DENIED. Google documents apikeys.keys.lookup as required; the 403 is consistent with missing IAM permission.
